stories.title: Elon Musk's Starlink blocked from operating in Namibia
stories.summary: Namibia's telecommunications regulator has blocked Starlink from operating in the country, citing that the SpaceX subsidiary does not meet local ownership requirements.

stories.title: Bill Cosby found guilty of 1972 sexual assault, victim awarded nearly $60m
stories.summary: Bill Cosby has been found guilty of a 1972 sexual assault, with the victim awarded nearly $60 million in damages. The actor faces allegations of sexual misconduct from at least 60 women, all of which he denies.

stories.title: Amazon says AWS Bahrain region ‘disrupted’ following drone activity
stories.summary: Amazon Web Services reported disruptions at its Bahrain region following drone activity, marking the second time in a month that AWS operations have been affected by the ongoing Iran war.

stories.title: Iran launches waves of missiles towards Israel
stories.summary: Iran launched waves of missiles toward Israel, with Israel's Magen David Adom emergency medical service reporting six people sustained light injuries in the strikes.

stories.title: Iran says no talks with US, calls Trump statements a ‘bluff’
stories.summary: Iranian officials have dismissed statements by US President Trump as a 'bluff,' denying any direct or indirect negotiations with the United States.

stories.title: Colombian military plane crash kills at least 66
stories.summary: A Colombian military plane crash has killed at least 66 people. Colombia's defence minister described it as a tragic accident, though the cause remains unclear.

stories.title: Inside the alleged Russian operation to trigger anti-government protests in Angola
stories.summary: A group of Russians and Angolans are standing trial in Angola on accusations of orchestrating anti-government protests, charges which the defendants deny.

stories.title: UK universities flock to India - but will they succeed?
stories.summary: Nine UK universities are establishing campuses in India, though initial student enrolment is expected to be modest.

stories.title: Oil falls and shares rebound after Trump says talks have been held to end war
stories.summary: Oil prices fell and stock markets rebounded after US President Trump stated that 'very good and productive' talks have been held to end the war.

stories.title: A committed pharmacist and a homesick blogger – the Iranian civilians killed in the war
stories.summary: Civilian casualties continue to rise in Iran as the US-Israeli military campaign continues, with victims including a pharmacist and a blogger among those killed.

stories.title: Ex-teacher accused of Scotland school abuse found guilty of sex attack in South Africa
stories.summary: A court in Cape Town, South Africa found former Scottish teacher Iain Wares guilty of indecently assaulting a former student who accused him of sexual abuse dating back to the 1980s.

stories.title: US' and Iran's options for ending war narrow the longer it goes on
stories.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran shows no signs of resolution, with Iran refusing to back down and US air power alone proving insufficient to achieve its primary objectives.

stories.title: Israeli settlers target Palestinian villages in occupied West Bank, attacking people and properties
stories.summary: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian villages and properties in the occupied West Bank following the death of 18-year-old settler Yehuda Sherman, who was reportedly struck by a Palestinian-driven vehicle while on his quad bike.

stories.title: National blackout hits Cuba for second time in a week
stories.summary: Cuba experienced its second nationwide blackout in a week due to a total failure of its power grid amid ongoing fuel shortages linked to US sanctions.

stories.title: Israel to expand ground and air attacks against Hezbollah in Lebanon
stories.summary: Israel has announced plans to expand ground and air operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon, raising fears of a large-scale ground invasion.

stories.title: Iranian missiles injure 180 in towns near Israeli nuclear site
stories.summary: An Iranian ballistic missile strike injured approximately 180 people in towns near an Israeli nuclear facility, prompting Israeli authorities to investigate how the missiles penetrated the country's air defense systems.

stories.title: Car stolen with two-month-old baby inside
stories.summary: A car was stolen with a two-month-old baby boy inside, but police quickly located the vehicle and rescued the infant unharmed, reuniting him with his mother shortly after the incident.

stories.title: Venezuelan leader replaces senior military commanders
stories.summary: Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro replaced senior military commanders following the appointment of a new defence minister by Vice President Delcy Rodríguez, a reshuffling that human rights organizations have criticized as perpetuating a lack of accountability.
